title: Construct Team
description: A team is an explicitly-defined organizational unit with clear accountability, decision rights, forbidden decisions, escalation paths, and contact info. Teams are the primary organizational structure in the redesigned model.

id.description: Unique team identifier (e.g., product-group, platform-group, research-group). Used in policy gates and escalation paths.

name.description: Human-readable team name (e.g., Product Group, Platform Group, Research Group).

owner.description: Role id of the team owner/lead (e.g., product-manager, platform-engineer, researcher). This person holds primary accountability for team decisions.

roles.description: List of role ids that constitute this team.

decisionRights.description: Decisions this team is authorized to make. Examples: intake-triage, design-approval, deployment, scope-change, etc.

forbiddenDecisions.description: Decisions this team explicitly cannot make. Attempts to make forbidden decisions escalate automatically.

escalationPath.description: Chain of escalation for unresolved decisions. First element is the team owner, then subsequent elements for higher-level escalation.

charter.description: One-paragraph mission statement: what this team owns, what it doesn't own, and key constraints. Written in voice of accountability, not aspiration.

owner.description: Direct contact for the team owner (name or email).

evidence.description: Primary sources justifying this team's structure (interviews, job specs, ADRs, organizational research).
